source.interpretation: Optional Item.NCFTL defaults to infinite/unset tolerance. With finite 0.2 calendar hours, the accepted parent demonstrated escalation while the noncritical zero-stock repair was waiting. Keeping NCFTT=CALENDAR fixed isolates whether omitting the tolerance leaves that wait noncritical.

predeclared_hypotheses_not_outcomes: The unset child retains the accepted finite control's first noncritical LRU failure near h9.8829, succeeds in the h10 mission and creates a local spare backorder on return.
With no local spare and no NCFTL value, physical replacement repair remains pending and no time-based criticality escalation occurs through h36.
The aircraft remains eligible for the h20 and h32 missions despite its pending noncritical repair; all three scheduled missions may succeed if no later random fault intervenes.
The existing backorder remains unresolved at h36 because no physical removal can begin while the task remains noncritical and waiting for a replacement item.
Native event order, report values and terminal state are outcomes; failed hypotheses constrain acceptance and cannot be silently rewritten.
native_acceptance_gates: Exact parent/child source fingerprints and single Item.NCFTL plus description delta verified before native execution.
Session-0 SSH, host-wide mutex, active GUI PID13340 identity, unchanged installed executable/manual/dictionary, zero converter errors, valid nonempty SXO and reports.
All authored row-containing tables import/export identically; event log distinguishes a started waiting task from physical repair work.
Separate read-only reviewer replays individual missions, noncritical task pause/resume, stock/backorder and 72-bin system/stock/terminal results against the accepted finite control.
